content.title: Oxford Biomedica completes acquisition of remaining stake in U.S. subsidiary
content.summary: OXB has acquired the remaining 10% stake in its US subsidiary from Q32 Bio (QTTB), bringing its ownership, as planned, to 100%. As previously disclosed in the Company’s Preliminary Results on 9 April, OXB US exercised its call option on 1 March to acquire the final 10% interest in OXB US from Q32. The stake was originally held by Homology Medicines, which merged with Q32 in 2024. The transfer of Q32’s 10% holding to OXB US, means that OXB US is now wholly owned by OXB.
